title.narrative: Adaptation of smallholder farmers to climate change in Rodrigues: ¿Setting up of an Integrated organic chilli farm at Montagne du Sable and a lime and honey farm at Anse Ali¿

description.narrative: The overall objective of the proposed project is to set up integrated organic farms at Montagne du Sable (North-West) and Anse Ali (North-East) that will both promote sustainable mixed farming practices. This project aims at increasing the production of high value products identified by CIRAD and to provide sustainable livelihoods for people enrolled in the Employment Relief Programme (ERP), Plan de Prestation Transitoire, and beneficiaries of Unemployment Hardship Relief (UHR) in both regions
